'''Arigo''' was the nickname of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] agent of [[Exchange|The Exchange]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], working in weapons trafficking. He was [[Zeerid Korr]]'s contact until [[3653 BBY]], when Arigo was presumed killed by a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] or [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], which included [[Scar (criminal)|Scar]] and [[No Scar]]. Korr was scheduled to deliver a weapons shipment to Arigo, but instead encountered Scar and his gang. They posed as men sent by Arigo, but Korr realized the situation and killed the men.
